notes: Curated submission windows for prize entrants. Every entry must carry `verifiedOn` and `sourceUrl` pointing at the page it was read from. Dates are cyclical: `nextCloseDate` is the concrete close of the cycle we verified, and `closesOn`/`opensOn` (MM-DD) are the recurring rule used once that date passes, so a stale entry degrades to an approximate annual date instead of a wrong one. Leave an award out entirely rather than guessing; the UI shows 'Not yet sourced'. Keys are award ids for standalone prizes and prize-registry ids under `programs` for multi-category programs.

award-ackerley-prize-autobiography-and-m.note: The judges do not accept submissions from publishers or authors; they call in books themselves.

award-american-library-in-paris-book-awa.eligibility: English-language publication between 1 July 2026 and 30 June 2027
award-american-library-in-paris-book-awa.note: Anyone — author, publisher, agent, or reader — may submit. The 2027 window opens 1 November 2026.

award-andrew-carnegie-medal-for-excellen.note: Selected by a committee of library professionals; there is no public call for entries.

award-arthur-ross-book-award-internation.window: Annual nomination cycle; no published deadline
award-arthur-ross-book-award-internation.note: Nominations are emailed to CFR with the title, author, publication date, and publisher.

award-baillie-gifford-prize-for-non-fict.eligibility: Published in English in the UK between 1 November 2025 and 31 October 2026
award-baillie-gifford-prize-for-non-fict.note: Publishers may submit up to three titles per imprint, plus up to three call-in suggestions.

award-bancroft-prize.window: Annual cycle; the close date is announced each year
award-bancroft-prize.note: Publishers submit; Columbia announces the entry deadline for each cycle on the prize page.

award-barbara-and-david-zalaznick-book-p.eligibility: Nonfiction on American history or biography copyrighted in the previous year
award-barbara-and-david-zalaznick-book-p.fee: No fee; five copies of each book are required

award-british-academy-book-prize.eligibility: First published in English in the UK between 1 April 2025 and 30 April 2026
award-british-academy-book-prize.note: Hard copies must arrive within a week of the closing date.

award-chicago-tribune-heartland-prize-no.note: Chicago Tribune literary staff select from recently published titles; there is no open call for entries.

award-costa-book-awards-biography.window: Discontinued in 2022; the 2021 awards were the last
award-costa-book-awards-biography.note: Costa ended the awards after 50 years, so there is no current entry route.

award-cundill-history-prize.note: 2026 submissions closed 27 February 2026; the next round opens in early 2027.

award-dayton-literary-peace-prize-nonfic.eligibility: First US copyright date in the previous calendar year
award-dayton-literary-peace-prize-nonfic.note: Any person may nominate; entries are filed through the online form.

award-duff-cooper-prize-history-biograph.eligibility: Published by an imprint with a formal UK presence between 1 January and 31 December 2026
award-duff-cooper-prize-history-biograph.fee: No entry charge, but shortlisted titles incur a £1,000 publisher contribution
award-duff-cooper-prize-history-biograph.note: A title may be submitted only by its UK publisher; direct author submissions are not accepted.

award-edgar-awards-best-fact-crime.eligibility: Published during the 2026 calendar year for the 2027 Edgars
award-edgar-awards-best-fact-crime.fee: No entry fee, and no limit on entries
award-edgar-awards-best-fact-crime.note: MWA prefers publisher submissions, but authors may submit. Works must reach the judges by the cutoff.

award-elizabeth-longford-prize-for-histo.note: There are no submissions; the prize calls in books from publishers each January at the judges' request.

award-francis-parkman-prize.eligibility: Nonfiction history on an American theme published the previous year; textbooks and edited collections are ineligible

award-frederick-douglass-book-prize-slav.window: Guidelines announced in January or early February, with a late-April or early-May deadline
award-frederick-douglass-book-prize-slav.eligibility: Books copyrighted in the previous calendar year
award-frederick-douglass-book-prize-slav.note: Publishers and authors are both invited to submit; inquiries go to the Gilder Lehrman Center at Yale.

award-ft-business-book-of-the-year.note: The 2026 award opened for entries on 27 April and closed 30 June.

award-george-perkins-marsh-prize-environ.eligibility: Books appearing between 1 November and 31 October of the following year
award-george-perkins-marsh-prize-environ.note: Anyone may submit. One hard copy must go to each committee member; electronic submissions are not accepted.

award-george-polk-awards-book-award.note: Books based on investigative reporting or about journalism may be entered; all submissions are electronic.

award-george-rosen-prize-public-health-a.window: AAHM nomination cycle; awarded in odd-numbered years
award-george-rosen-prize-public-health-a.note: Publishers nominating a monograph must send a copy to each committee member. The 2025–26 cycle closed 3 December 2025.

award-george-washington-prize-founding-e.eligibility: First published between 1 January and 31 December of the previous year
award-george-washington-prize-founding-e.note: Five copies go to the Fred W. Smith National Library at Mount Vernon.

award-gilder-lehrman-lincoln-prize-civil.note: Rolling submissions from 1 January; books should be submitted in the month they are published.

award-gilder-lehrman-military-history-pr.eligibility: Books copyrighted in 2026, with a primary focus on American military history
award-gilder-lehrman-military-history-pr.note: Send three copies and a cover note; entries go to bookprizes@gilderlehrman.org.

award-governor-general-s-literary-awards.eligibility: Titles published between 1 July 2025 and 30 April 2026
award-governor-general-s-literary-awards.note: Only eligible Canadian publishing houses may submit; four paper copies plus a PDF are required.

award-helen-bernstein-book-award-for-exc.eligibility: Full-length books by authors whose primary profession is journalism; fiction, biography, memoir, and history are ineligible
award-helen-bernstein-book-award-for-exc.note: Publishers, agents, or journalists may nominate; authors may not nominate their own books.

award-hilary-weston-writers-trust-prize-.note: Deadlines are staggered by publication date — 11 February, 15 April, and 24 June in the 2026 cycle.

award-hillman-prize-for-book-journalism.note: The book category covers long-form nonfiction; two copies and a 1–2 page cover letter are required.

award-ire-awards-books.eligibility: Published between 1 January and 31 December of the award year
award-ire-awards-books.note: Only ebooks are accepted for the book category.

award-j-anthony-lukas-book-prize.note: Shares the Lukas Prize Project cycle with the Mark Lynton History Prize.

award-james-tait-black-prizes-biography.eligibility: Written in or translated into English and published in the calendar year of the award; must be purchasable in the UK
award-james-tait-black-prizes-biography.note: Submissions go direct to the judges, two copies preferred; there is no limit on titles per publisher.

award-john-burroughs-medal.eligibility: Narrative natural history published within the prior three calendar years
award-john-burroughs-medal.note: Publishers email the association to nominate, then send seven copies. Deadlines shift slightly each summer.

award-kirkus-prize-for-nonfiction.note: Every book that earns a starred Kirkus review in the eligibility window is automatically considered; there is no separate entry.

award-laura-shannon-prize-european-studi.note: Nominations run through the Nanovic Institute form; the prize alternates between History & Social Sciences and Humanities cycles.

award-lionel-gelber-prize-international-.note: All titles must be submitted by the publisher: seven copies plus an electronic copy and a submission form.

award-margaret-w-rossiter-history-of-wom.window: HSS nomination cycle; the book prize is awarded in odd-numbered years
award-margaret-w-rossiter-history-of-wom.note: Covers books published at most four years before the award year. Recent HSS cycles have closed in mid-December.

award-mark-lynton-history-prize.note: Entry materials and fees for the 2026 cycle were due 31 January 2026.

award-national-book-critics-circle-award.note: No formal entry deadline. Publishers may bring books to the board's attention, and early submission is encouraged.

award-ncr-book-award-nonfiction.note: The NCR Book Award ended in 1997 and was a forerunner of the Baillie Gifford Prize.

award-nero-book-awards-non-fiction.window: Publishers enter in June and July
award-nero-book-awards-non-fiction.eligibility: Published in the UK and Ireland; the author must have lived in the UK or Ireland for three years
award-nero-book-awards-non-fiction.note: 2026 entries are closed. The shortlist is announced in December and category winners in January.

award-overseas-press-club-awards-corneli.eligibility: Published in the US, or by a US-based company, for the first time during the previous calendar year
award-overseas-press-club-awards-corneli.note: Books may be entered only for the Cornelius Ryan and Olivier Rebbot awards.

award-pen-diamonstein-spielvogel-award-f.fee: $85 per submission; waived for publishers with annual net sales under $2 million
award-pen-diamonstein-spielvogel-award-f.note: Submissions for the 2027 PEN America Literary Awards close 1 August 2026.

award-pen-e-o-wilson-literary-science-wr.fee: $85 per submission; waived for publishers with annual net sales under $2 million
award-pen-e-o-wilson-literary-science-wr.note: Submissions for the 2027 PEN America Literary Awards close 1 August 2026.

award-pen-hessell-tiltman-prize-historic.window: Annual cycle; submissions were closed when last checked
award-pen-hessell-tiltman-prize-historic.eligibility: First British publication in English, published 1 January–31 December of the previous year; history only, not historical biography, and no translations
award-pen-hessell-tiltman-prize-historic.note: Publishers may draw attention to no more than two books on their lists or imprints.

award-pen-jacqueline-bograd-weld-award-f.fee: $85 per submission; waived for publishers with annual net sales under $2 million
award-pen-jacqueline-bograd-weld-award-f.note: Submissions for the 2027 PEN America Literary Awards close 1 August 2026.

award-pen-john-kenneth-galbraith-award-f.fee: $85 per submission; waived for publishers with annual net sales under $2 million
award-pen-john-kenneth-galbraith-award-f.note: Submissions for the 2027 PEN America Literary Awards close 1 August 2026.

award-pfizer-award-history-of-science.window: HSS nomination cycle; recent cycles have closed in mid-December
award-pfizer-award-history-of-science.eligibility: Books published in English during the three calendar years preceding the competition

award-plutarch-award-biography.window: Nominations close in the winter, ahead of the March longlist
award-plutarch-award-biography.note: BIO members nominate biographies, including their own; a committee of five biographers selects the winner.

award-rachel-carson-environment-book-awa.eligibility: Original copyright in the previous calendar year and publicly available
award-rachel-carson-environment-book-awa.fee: $110 general / $45 SEJ member; late entries accepted for two weeks at double the fee

award-rbc-taylor-prize-literary-non-fict.note: The trustees ended the prize after 20 years; 2020 was the final award.

award-ridenhour-book-prize.window: Nominations open ahead of the spring prize ceremony
award-ridenhour-book-prize.note: No published deadline; contact the Ridenhour Prizes for the current nomination window.

award-robert-f-kennedy-book-award.eligibility: Published between 1 January and 31 December of the previous year

award-royal-society-science-book-prize.eligibility: First English publication between 1 October 2025 and 30 September 2026
award-royal-society-science-book-prize.note: Books must be submitted by the publisher. Now the Royal Society Trivedi Science Book Prize.

award-shaughnessy-cohen-prize-for-politi.window: Writers' Trust annual cycle; see the prize guidelines for current dates
award-shaughnessy-cohen-prize-for-politi.note: Canadian publishers may enter two books, plus one more for every ten additional eligible nonfiction titles, to a maximum of five.

award-suzanne-j-levinson-prize-history-o.eligibility: Books in the history of the life sciences and natural history published in the previous four years

award-truman-capote-award-for-literary-c.note: Winners are nominated and selected each year by a panel of judges; there is no open submission process.

award-wellcome-book-prize-nonfiction.note: Wellcome suspended the prize after its tenth anniversary and has not restarted it.

award-william-h-welch-medal-medical-hist.window: AAHM nomination cycle; the committee welcomes suggestions
award-william-h-welch-medal-medical-hist.eligibility: Books (not edited volumes) published during the five calendar years preceding the award
award-william-h-welch-medal-medical-hist.note: Publishers nominating a book send a copy to each committee member.

award-wolfson-history-prize.window: Annual submission cycle; dates published on the prize site

award-women-s-prize-for-non-fiction.eligibility: UK publishers submit; see the terms of entry for the publication window
award-women-s-prize-for-non-fiction.note: For the 2026 prize, submissions opened 7 July 2025 and online entry forms were due 29 August 2025.

aha-book-prizes.window: Annual cycle; each AHA prize publishes its own call
aha-book-prizes.note: Deadlines differ by prize; check the individual AHA prize pages.

anisfield-wolf-book-awards.eligibility: Written in English and published and copyrighted in 2026 for the 2027 prize
anisfield-wolf-book-awards.note: Authors may submit their own work, but publisher submissions are strongly advised.

james-beard-book-awards.window: Open call runs in the autumn
james-beard-book-awards.note: The 2026 Media Awards open call has closed; entries run through the James Beard awards platform.

los-angeles-times-book-prize.note: Judges select from books published during the eligibility year; there is no external nominating process.

national-book-awards.note: The 2026 entry form closed 13 May 2026 at 5:00 p.m. PDT; publishers submit on behalf of authors.

national-jewish-book-awards.eligibility: 2026 copyright; the author must be living on 1 January 2026
national-jewish-book-awards.note: Entry forms and digital copies go through the Jewish Book Council portal, plus seven or twelve print copies by category.

oah-book-prizes.note: Publishers submit; most OAH book awards close 1 October, though individual prizes list their own terms.

orwell-prize.eligibility: Published in the UK or Ireland between 1 June and 31 May by a recognised UK or Irish publisher
orwell-prize.note: The call for entries goes out to publishers in November; hard copies follow a few days after the form deadline.

phi-beta-kappa-book-awards.note: Nominations for the 2026 awards closed 15 November 2025.

prose-awards.eligibility: Works carrying the prior year's copyright
prose-awards.note: The 2026 awards accepted entries from 22 September to 10 November 2025.

pulitzer-prize.eligibility: Books published in the United States during the calendar year
pulitzer-prize.note: Entries for 2026-published books close 15 October 2026 at 5:30 p.m. Eastern.

wainwright-prize.eligibility: First published between 1 June 2025 and 31 May 2026; proofs accepted for titles due before that date
wainwright-prize.fee: No entry fee; longlisted titles pay a shortlist levy toward promotion
wainwright-prize.note: Publishers submit with author and illustrator consent.
